program.intent: Pack syslog-like yearless timestamp into one monotonic integer and preserve spacing for exact reconstruction.
program.code:
def forward(groups):
    month, sp1, day, sp2, time = groups
    text = month + ' ' + day.zfill(2) + ' ' + time
    dt = datetime.strptime(text, '%b %d %H:%M:%S')
    monotonic = dt.month * 100000000 + dt.day * 1000000 + dt.hour * 10000 + dt.minute * 100 + dt.second
    layout = [len(sp1), len(sp2), len(day)]
    return {'stored': [monotonic], 'layout': layout}

def inverse(record):
    monotonic = record['stored'][0]
    layout = record.get('layout', [])
    sp1_len, sp2_len, day_width = layout
    month = (monotonic // 100000000) % 100
    day = (monotonic // 1000000) % 100
    hour = (monotonic // 10000) % 100
    minute = (monotonic // 100) % 100
    second = monotonic % 100
    dt = datetime(2000, month, day, hour, minute, second)  # Use year 2000 as placeholder
    return dt.strftime('%b') + (' ' * sp1_len) + str(day).zfill(day_width) + (' ' * sp2_len) + dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
